note: BLOCKED: real match footage is the ground every line is drawn on (STYLE.md §1). "Last Train Home" is a fictional animated story: no real footage of it exists. Building this style on our own animated master would mean putting a filter over the original film (the brief forbids it), and fabricating footage that looks real would present a simulation as authentic recording (the brief forbids that too). Not substituted with a generic version.
short: Lines drawn on real match footage; the story is fiction.
